fields.summary: The plan step of a plan run on change set 6 of milestone 3 (The build workflow), 2026-10-27. Starting from the settled milestone-3 decisions (build-workflow-shape, verifier-writes-evidence, full-agent-sessions, engine-is-conductor, one-worktree-first) and the one leaf already written (run-program-status), the planner put six topics to the owner, each through AskUserQuestion with a recommendation; the owner picked the recommended option in each. Settled: (1) the per-leaf loop is a new `leaves` step kind in the workflow file, with builder and verifier sub-tables, conducted and journaled by the engine; (2) each verifier runs in a throwaway detached worktree at the leaf's commit, its Evidence written into the build worktree's log, so verifiers stay parallel; (3) 3 builder attempts in all, a model ladder per attempt (default sonnet, opus, opus; verifier opus), the Claude adapter gaining a model flag, and each retry a fresh builder session that reads the verifier's journaled findings; (4) a retry adds a fix commit with the same Leaf: trailer, and the engine commits only the Evidence entry's path as its own chore(rhiza) commit; (5) one tab per build, builder pane and verifier panes, a pane closed when its session passes and failed or blocked panes kept until the run ends; on the owner's typed ask, splits follow the pane's shape in pixels (along the longer side, the builder keeping half), with a `split` override in build.toml; (6) a failed leaf lets independent leaves carry on and the run ends failed, a resume after the leaf's question is answered gives it a fresh round (in autonomous mode the arbiter answers and the engine gives one fresh round); needed outside work is a question, noticed-only work a discovered-from draft change set; the run ends with rhiza run build-check and does not land. The picks are captured as Decisions by session interview; the leaves link the landed milestone-3 decisions.
